intro.text: Vun Makak is one of the gods of the Purelake's people.

description.text: Purelakers see him as the spiteful, jealous younger brother of Nu Ralik. Believing they must trick him into thinking they worship him rather than his brother, they swear by Vun Makak in daily life and keep Nu Ralik's name for their holy grottos.
He is generally believed to blight or curse those who claim to follow him, and is linked with lying.
